title: Alien Breed, supplied SPS998 Game Disk1/2 IPF release

build.scope: Fresh F17/Lemmings disk root and integrated Exec, plus the source graphics installer with its private resident moved to FF8000. The four preceding root sources are unchanged. Ten other component DLLs, including System/DOS/device/SDK/compiler and the graphics composer, remain frozen. This is separate from complete current-main/MorphOS ROM or standard-app qualification.
build.inheritedManifestNote: Ancestral manifest entries for CPU/engine/components describe their original build, not the current execution identities or rebuilt Exec. Actual execution binaries, all retained inputs, rebuilt Exec and fresh root are recorded here.
build.layoutCorrection: The first integrated compile extended beyond FF0000 and the link guard rejected its overlap. The private graphics resident and its source installer now use FF8000. No compiled ROM/game bytes were patched; the native root was recompiled, and overlap/checksum/framework gates remain enabled.

Focused source tests use separate moving compiler/SDK build outputs; media replay binaries remain frozen.

exploration.supersededCandidate: The first isolated Exec candidate used the older branch source and omitted bootstrap changes already present in the frozen binary. It was stopped before producing a qualified image. Its artifacts are not successful coverage. The final image instead records the integrated committed Exec sources and all retained components.

rejectedLayoutCompile.interpretation: Failed composition: code crossed the original FF0000 graphics start. No linked image or game replay from this compile qualifies.

receiptMode: --firmware native disables interpretation of private boot receipts after takeover; hashes identify the actual firmware. Guest execution is unchanged.
limits: Bounded disk swap, menu, briefing and opening gameplay only; story disk, later levels, game completion, save/write paths and other profiles remain unverified.
Ten component DLLs remain frozen; this is not execution qualification of the complete merged producer tree, its updated graphics image, standard-app admission or installed MSIX.
No engine or CPU/package change, game/opcode/media patch, host OS shim or artifact publication.
Sampled PCM parity is not listening or audio-fidelity qualification. Correctness diagnostics are separate from throughput acceptance.

mainBackport.scope: Narrow native supervisor backport onto current main, preserving its independent task-completion bridge. Emitter source matches the qualified native branch; this does not claim a complete current-main ROM replay.

correctedTrace.interpretation: Both original loader calls return with its modified trap-zero vector intact. Addresses differ from the old F17 image because integrated bootstrap/Exec layout changed.
